meta.name: cellxgene-census
meta.description: Query the CZ CELLxGENE Census programmatically for versioned public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data. Use when you need population-scale cell metadata, gene expression slices, Census summary counts, source H5AD URIs/downloads, embeddings, spatial Census data, or reference atlas comparisons across organisms, tissues, diseases, assays, and cell types. For analyzing your own local single-cell data use scanpy, anndata, or scvi-tools.

copy.tagline_en: Query public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data on demand

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 Python 查询 CELLxGENE Census 的公开单细胞与空间转录组数据,按细胞类型、组织、疾病等条件筛选,产出元数据、基因表达矩阵、计数或 H5AD 下载地址。
howto.when: 当你需要查询公开单细胞或空间转录组数据,例如细胞元数据、基因表达切片、计数统计等时触发;分析自己的本地数据应改用 scanpy 或 anndata。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude queries the public CZ CELLxGENE Census via Python: filter cells by type, tissue or disease and return metadata, gene expression matrices, counts, embeddings or H5AD download links.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need public single-cell or spatial transcriptomics data such as cell metadata, gene expression slices or summary counts; for your own local data use scanpy instead.
